cms_short_title: Keep complete, dated laboratory records in the resident's record.

passages.text: §483.50(a)(2) The facility must— (iv) File in the resident's clinical record laboratory reports that are dated and contain the name and address of the testing laboratory.

Review the resident’s clinical record to determine laboratory reports are included and that the reports are dated and contain the name and address of the testing laboratory. If there are other medical record documentation concerns, refer to §483.70(h) - Medical Records.

To cite deficient practice at F775, the surveyor’s investigation will generally show that the facility failed to do any one or more of the following: • Have laboratory reports filed in the resident’s clinical record; OR • Laboratory reports were not dated; OR • Laboratory reports did not contain the name and address of the testing laboratory.
